name: Vicious Stomp
benefit:
Whenever an opponent falls prone adjacent to you, that opponent provokes an attack of opportunity from you. This attack must be an unarmed strike.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 135
When an opponent provokes an unarmed strike attack of opportunity from you by falling prone, you can spend 2 stamina points to deal an additional 1d6 points of damage with that unarmed strike.
flavor: You take advantage of the moment to brutally kick an enemy when he is down.
